visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand tilts a glass carafe, pouring a light brown milk-coffee mixture into a clear, double-walled glass decorated with flower patterns. Sunlight streams in from a window in the background, illuminating green foliage outside. Large pink and white Chinese text overlays the bottom half of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a hand holding a blue and silver retail package of 'Water Drip Coffee' by Cafe Kaldi. An I-Mei milk carton sits in the blurred background. Yellow and black variety text appears at the bottom. (3) A close-up shows the back of the coffee package, highlighting the numbered instruction icons for brewing steps. White informative text with a black outline is visible at the bottom. (4) The view returns to the pouring action from a slightly different angle. The coffee mixture flows steadily into the glass, which is now half-full. (5) A final composition shows the full glass of coffee in the foreground with the I-Mei milk carton and Kaldi coffee package arranged neatly behind it on a white kitchen counter. (6) A shot inside a retail store displays rows of the same blue coffee packages on shelves. A decorative cartoon-style elephant figure is visible in the background, suggesting a boutique grocery environment.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. [Slogan]: 在家自製 比拿鐵還好喝的 奶萃咖啡 Milk Brew. (2) [Slogan]: 只要利用 冷萃咖啡專用包. (3) [Slogan]: 一般是加水後放置 改成全牛奶就可以了. (4) [Slogan]: 牛奶中放入咖啡包 冰箱放置8小時即可. (5) [Slogan]: 香濃好喝 不加一滴水 材料也只要兩個. (6) [Slogan]: 咖啡包很多地方有賣 我順路買樂連的地也不錯.
